title: Describing a City's Layout: *elnyúlva*, *szétágazva*, *áthidalva*
goal: I can describe how streets and buildings lie with a -va/-ve participle (*hossztengelyében elnyúlva*, *sugarasan szétágazva*, *szintkülönbséget áthidalva*).
I can name the parts of a city plan (*városszerkezet*, *látványtengely*, *térfal*).
I can write a sentence that describes a street or a bridge.

sections.title: Unit 23: The City and Its Buildings
body: This unit is about the city: how streets and buildings lie, how old facades are described, the debate about old and new buildings, firm judgements about buildings, and crowded and airy districts.
The unit ends with a text about Szerb Antal's 1935 guide to Budapest for a visitor from Mars.
